messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — planning to cut client SDK v2.1.0 tonight 22:00 UTC (rolling staged rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~2h). Need smoke owners + rollback ready. Please ack if you have any blocking concerns.

Alex Gupta: quick Q — does v2.1 rename the `X-Client-Version` header to `X-RW-Client`? Any immediate compat break for older proxies?

Maria Chen: Not a hard break. We added `X-RW-Client` but the server still accepts `X-Client-Version` for now; we flip strict mode behind a feature flag. The migration adds a telemetry field though — clients are encouraged to send both for one release.

Jon Park: I'll own canaries and smoke tests. Will run the canary job after the initial 10% pass and check latency + error-rate slices. Posting the smoke commands I'll use below.

Jon Park: ```
# run the smoke suite against canary pool
./scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --env=canary --suite=client-integration --timeout=10m
# quick perf check (p95/p99)
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?job=sdk_canary&metric=latency_p95" | jq .
```

Samira Patel: I'll draft the client-facing note & changelog bullet. Do we have a short summary I can paste? Also flagging partners with early access.

Maria Chen: TL;DR for changelog: "Added `X-RW-Client` header (backwards compatible), telemetry field for routing, minor bugfixes for streaming reconnects." Keep it short, link to the breaking toggle in feature-flags doc.

Tess O'Neill: I'll own rollback/runbook. If error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m or latency p95 increases >30% we trigger automated rollback with deploy-bot. Revert command: `deploy-bot revert release sdk-client-v2.1.0 --reason "canary errors"` — I'll keep an eye on the dashboards.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: SDK client v2.1.0 | rollout windows: 22:00 UTC start, 22:12 bump to 50%, 00:00 target 100% | monitoring hooks attached. See https://deploys.internal/runs/98421

Alex Gupta: ack. I'll watch client error traces and proxy logs. Will add a temporary alert for header parsing exceptions.

Maria Chen: thanks — if everyone is set, we’ll proceed on schedule. Quick checklist: 1) canary smoke owner (Jon) 2) rollback owner (Tess) 3) client comms (Samira) 4) docs PR + changelog (Samira/Tess) 5) alert tweaks (Alex) 6) automated rollback enabled (deploy-bot). If you need a hand ping me or put a :warning: in #eng-oncall.

Samira Patel: :thumbsup: starting the comms draft now, will ping with the draft for review in ~20m.

Jon Park: will post canary run results in this thread as soon as the first 10% window completes.

Tess O'Neill: I'll hang near the deploy console. If anything looks off I'll trigger the revert and post steps here.

Maria Chen: Great — appreciate the quick sync. Minimal risk but good to be ready.
